title: Portable Named Agent Contract
description: Canonical schema for repo-independent named agents with role, charter, Skillex pack binding, and traveling Hindsight memory.

schema_version.description: Version of the named agent contract schema.

id.description: Canonical unique identifier for the named agent.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the agent.

role.description: Role identifier for the specialist agent.

purpose.description: One-line or short statement of agent purpose.

directives.description: Guiding principles and operational directives for the agent.

pack.description: Name or reference of the Skillex pack binding.

write_bank.description: Personal write memory bank, strictly formatted as agent-<name>.

recall_banks.description: Ordered list of memory banks to recall, with personal write bank typically first.

path.description: Filesystem path to the agent desk directory.
